name: Simplex Holdings, Inc.
summary: Simplex Holdings, Inc. provides IT solutions related to system consulting, system development, and system operation and maintenance in Japan. The company offers strategic/dx consulting, including forming management strategy, business strategy formation, organizational reform, and business process transformation; and shared service/software as a service. It is also involved in subscription and licensing activities; and sells goods, such as hardware and middleware. Simplex Holdings,Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
